title: Upper Austrian peasant war of 1626
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Upper Austrian peasant war of 1626", at revision 1370752539, opens: "The Upper Austrian peasant war of 1626 was a rebellion led by farmers whose goal was to free Upper Austria from Bavarian rule. The motive was an escalation of the Bavarian Electorate's attempt to press the country into the Catholic faith at the time of the Thirty Years' War." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2011601, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "Military conflict". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
